territorial_scope.description: Applies to controllers and processors handling personal data in Switzerland; the cross-border disclosure rules also bind controllers and processors that send data to recipients abroad.

evidence.quote: Gibt der Verantwortliche oder der Auftragsbearbeiter Personendaten mittels Standarddatenschutzklauseln nach Artikel 16 Absatz 2 Buchstabe d DSG ins Ausland bekannt, so trifft er angemessene Massnahmen

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Swiss federal data protection ordinance under the FADP. It sets data security measures, logging and processing-regulation duties, cross-border disclosure safeguards, data subject access and portability procedures, and rules for federal bodies' registration and pilot projects. Applies from 1 September 2023.
summary.long: The Datenschutzverordnung (DSV) implements the Federal Act on Data Protection and applies to controllers and processors. Articles 1-3 require protection-needs assessments and technical and organisational security measures calibrated to risk. Article 4 requires logging of automated processing of especially sensitive personal data at large scale or high-risk profiling where preventive measures are insufficient, and Articles 5-6 require processing regulations in defined cases. Articles 8-12 govern disclosure abroad: an adequacy list in Annex 1, standard data protection clauses, binding corporate rules, and codes of conduct or certifications, with the EDÖB approving certain instruments. Articles 13-15 set information duties, a two-year retention period for data protection impact assessments, and breach notification to the EDÖB. Articles 16-22 set procedures for access and data portability rights, including a 30-day response period and a fee cap of 300 francs. Articles 23-28 regulate data protection advisers, and Article 24 exempts firms with fewer than 250 employees from keeping processing records unless sensitive data or high-risk profiling is involved. Articles 31-34 regulate notification and pilot trials by federal bodies. Article 44 sets EDÖB fees. The ordinance entered into force on 1 September 2023.

thresholds.variable_text: Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter (Unternehmen und andere privatrechtliche Organisationen)
thresholds.measurement: Number of employees on 1 January of a year
thresholds.consequence: Exempt from the duty to keep a register of processing activities, unless high-risk processing of sensitive personal data on a large scale or high-risk profiling applies
thresholds.conditions: Applies to undertakings and other private-law organisations and to natural persons; exemption lost if (a) sensitive personal data are processed on a large scale or (b) high-risk profiling is carried out

evidence.quote: Unternehmen und andere privatrechtliche Organisationen, die am 1. Januar eines Jahres weniger als 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter beschäftigen

thresholds.variable_text: Beteiligung an den Kosten der Auskunftserteilung (Höchstbetrag)
thresholds.measurement: Amount of the cost contribution charged per access request
thresholds.consequence: Ceiling on the cost contribution the controller may request from the data subject for information that involves disproportionate effort
thresholds.conditions: Applies where providing the information involves disproportionate effort (unverhältnismässiger Aufwand)

evidence.quote: Die Beteiligung beträgt maximal 300 Franken.

thresholds.value_text: Stundenansatz von 150 bis 250 Franken, je nach Funktion des ausführenden Personals
thresholds.measurement: Hourly rate charged for time spent by the EDÖB
thresholds.consequence: Fee rate per hour varies within the range according to the function of the staff member performing the service
thresholds.conditions: Fees are calculated on time spent; the rate within the range depends on the function of the executing staff

evidence.quote: Es gilt ein Stundenansatz von 150 bis 250 Franken, je nach Funktion des ausführenden Personals.

thresholds.variable_text: Zuschlag auf die Gebühr (aussergewöhnlicher Umfang, besondere Schwierigkeit oder Dringlichkeit)
thresholds.value_text: Zuschläge bis zu 50 Prozent der Gebühr nach Absatz 2
thresholds.measurement: Surcharge as a percentage of the fee under Art. 44(2)
thresholds.consequence: EDÖB may charge a surcharge of up to 50 percent of the fee
thresholds.conditions: Applies to services of exceptional extent, particular difficulty or urgency

evidence.quote: Bei Dienstleistungen von aussergewöhnlichem Umfang, besonderer Schwierigkeit oder Dringlichkeit können Zuschläge bis zu 50 Prozent der Gebühr nach Absatz 2 erhoben werden.

thresholds.value_text: Zuschläge bis zu 100 Prozent der Gebühr nach Absatz 2
thresholds.measurement: Surcharge as a percentage of the fee under Art. 44(2)
thresholds.consequence: EDÖB may charge a surcharge of up to 100 percent of the fee
thresholds.conditions: Applies where the service may be reused by the fee payer for commercial purposes

evidence.quote: Kann die Dienstleistung des EDÖB von der gebührenpflichtigen Person zu kommerziellen Zwecken weiterverwendet werden, so können Zuschläge bis zu 100 Prozent der Gebühr nach Absatz 2 erhoben werden.
